name: Slasify
summary: Employer of record, global contractor payments and global payroll for companies hiring in countries where they have no entity, sold through a quote with a dedicated account manager.
best_for: companies hiring a few people in countries where they have no entity, especially in Southeast Asia, that want a low published EOR starting price and a dedicated account manager
skip_if: you want self-serve sign-up and a per-country price before talking to sales, or you need a published fee schedule for deposits and currency conversion
honest_knock: Only starting prices are public: EOR from $250 a month and contractors from $50 a month, with no statement that these are per worker, and Global Payroll is quote-only. The full fee list, including compliance and benefits-administration costs, only appears in the contract. The homepage says onboarding can take as little as 48 hours, while its own FAQ says 2 to 4 weeks. We have not used Slasify ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Employer of Record · per month, starting-at price on the pricing page
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-31 on slasify.com/pricing in a browser render, USD) Three services, each with a starting price and a custom quote. Employer of Record, marked most popular, starts at $250 a month. Global Contractor, for hiring, managing and paying contractors abroad, starts at $50 a month. Global Payroll is 'Available upon request'. The page does not say whether the starting prices are per worker, and its own FAQ says the price depends on the service, the number of workers and the countries involved, with all fees, including any compliance or benefits-administration costs, outlined in the initial contract. No free plan, trial, deposit, FX fee or minimum term is listed. A separate software-engineer outsourcing service is priced per quote.

schema_offer.description: Employer of Record, starting-at price on the pricing page; Global Contractor starts at $50 a month and Global Payroll is quoted; the final price depends on the service, the number of workers and the countries, and all fees are set out in the contract. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-31.

compare_with.name: Deel
compare_with.why: Deel is in our dossiers too; on our 9 October 2026 reading its EOR starts at $599 a month and contractor management at $49 a month, with self-serve contractor contracts, while Slasify publishes a lower EOR floor of $250 but sends every service through a quote
